description: This PHP class defines an interface for integrating with YouTrack issue tracker system within a test management environment, including connection handling, fetching issues, and creating issues via API.

classes.name: youtrackrestInterface
classes.description: A class to interact with YouTrack issue tracker via REST API, extending issueTrackerInterface, supporting issue retrieval, status checking, connection management, and issue creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, sets configuration, and attempts connection to YouTrack.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the API client instance used for communication with YouTrack.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a given bug ID.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the YouTrack system via API.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection to YouTrack is active.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches detailed data of a specific issue from YouTrack.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of the specified issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Provides a verbose, HTML-formatted status of the issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template configuration snippet for setting up YouTrack integration.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes the configuration object with default values if some are missing.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if an issue ID exists and is valid in YouTrack.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in YouTrack with specified summary and description.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether the system can create issues via API based on configuration.
